title: ACC View
description: Read-only: the vehicle ahead as a gap level, closing, the cruise / limiter set speed and the limit, drawn as a lane view on the centre screen and, as a test, on the cluster's map target. Writes nothing to the car.

de.bmw.dass.GapVehicleAhead._about: r1120 AA: the vehicle ahead as the front camera reports it (a FIELD with a notifier only, 32770; no getter, no setter), declared 's' as Signal Probe and Twin Dial do. Watched only while 'show' is on. Read only.

de.bmw.infotainment.displaydataserver.Di._about: r1120 AA: cruise / limiter (ldmSym, ldmSymColor, cruiseCtrlSpeedHUD), seen on the car 2026-11-18. Getter 1 (non-zero), notifier 32769. Read only.

de.bmw.infotainment.vehicle.Vehicle2._about: r1120 AA: our own speed (raw x 0.015625 km/h), for the time-gap levels. Read only.

de.bmw.infotainment.fasus.FASuS._about: r1120 AA: the car's own collision-warning request, declared in Signal Probe (S14), never seen with a value: logged only; drawn (our picture dimmed) only when config.warn names its path and active values. Read only.

de.bmw.dass.TrafficSignRecognition._about: r1120 AA2: the speed limit as the owner's car sends it (an EVENT, eventId 32769; seen 2026-11-18): presentClassLimitSpeed x 5 = km/h (shared/limit_src.js tsrOf, as Twin Dial). No getter, no setter, no method.

de.bmw.infotainment.vehicle.Vehicle._about: r1120 AA2: the car's own day / night, Twin Dial's source (config.dayNight). Getter 19 (non-zero), notifier 32787. Read only.

screens.name: MAIN
screens.title: ACC View
screens._about: r1120 AA2: the app's own page (the main view): one picture drawn by the app, E left and the data table right. Nothing on it can be pressed; the only button is the kit's Settings (the app's own two settings). The button's label is Latin: the kit's own bar font has no Cyrillic (LN, the languages agent, decides how labels change language).

settings.label: Показувати на щитку
settings._about: r1120 AA2: E on the cluster's map target (4 layers, AA-SPEC 3.1), a test: off by default. contend false, guide_hold 0.

settings.label: Демо: стани по колу
settings._about: the mockups' 14 states in turn (config.demoMs each), on both placements, no signals

layer._about: r1120 AA2 (docs/r1120/AA-SPEC.md 2.1, 3.1): E's four layers in the map target's core x 334..754, y 44..416: acc_lane effect 420 x 258 at (334, 158), acc_car effect (the car's box, moved and resized), text sheet 380 x 96 at (368, 54), pill sheet 340 x 44 at (374, 362). contend false: it waits until BMW's map leaves the slot and never pushes it aside. guideHold 0: BMW's CarPlay manoeuvre box is never held back for us.

warn._about: unknown until the car shows the struct: e.g. path ['someMember'], active ['SOME_ENUM']. Null: never drawn.

config._lang: words.js: 'uk' or 'en' ('auto' and anything else: Ukrainian). The languages module (LN) replaces this with its setting at the merge.
config._night: 'auto': the car's day / night (dayNight), else the sun at location; 'day' / 'night': a fixed look (the bench)

dayNight._from: fix/colour-daynight, from the car's catalogue (reference/car/2026-11-15/someip/someip-interfaces.json): Vehicle (service 46352, instance 1) field statusDayNightChangeOver, getter 19, notifier 32787, struct StatusDayNightChangeOverWrapper { dayNightChangeOver: enum DayNightChangeOver (default 3), destinationLCDLuminance, dampingLCDLuminance }. DayNightChangeOver: 0 KEINE_AENDERUNG (no change: the last day/night the car gave holds; none yet: the sun), 1 TAG (day), 2 NACHT (night), 3 SIGNAL_UNGUELTIG (invalid: the sun). Any other value counts as invalid. The meaning of 0 is read off its German name only and is UNCONFIRMED on the car. 'codes' turns an enum NAME back into its number for the log (numbers only). hud.js _isNight.

sign._about: shared/limit_src.js tsrCfg defaults (the event TrafficSignRecognition, presentClassLimitSpeed x 5, stale after 3 s)
